transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm here because I've been struggling with really severe mood swings. For about a year and two months, I've had periods where I feel incredibly high, energetic, and hyperactive. But then it shifts, and for the last eight months, I've been dealing with phases where I feel deeply depressed, empty, and completely exhausted.
Have you ever had hallucinations or strongly fixed beliefs that others said weren’t true during times when your mood was otherwise normal, not high or depressed?

No, I've never had any hallucinations or beliefs like that when my mood was normal. Those kinds of experiences only seem to happen when my mood is really elevated. When I'm feeling stable, my mind is completely clear.
During your high-energy periods, have you ever needed to be hospitalized, become unable to function normally, or gone several days with very little sleep and still felt full of energy?
I definitely experience those high-energy periods where I feel like I can do anything, but I have never needed to be hospitalized. I also haven't gone days without sleeping or felt completely unable
When your mood is very elevated, do you ever hear or see things others don’t, or become convinced of things that others say aren’t true?

I don't hear or see things that aren't actually there. However, when my mood is elevated, I do get firmly convinced of things others disagree with, like believing I am an incredibly special person with a unique, grand mission.
How long do these elevated periods usually last, and do they cause major problems like risky behavior, serious trouble at work or school, or people saying you seem out of control?

These elevated periods have been happening on and off for about a year and two months. During these times, I take on way too much work, become extremely social, and feel like I can accomplish absolutely anything. People around me definitely notice because I'm constantly on the go, talking rapidly, and just can't seem to sit still.
When one of these high-energy periods happens, about how many days in a row does it last without stopping?

Actually, it hasn't just been a few days at a time. This high-energy period has been lasting continuously for about one year and two months without stopping. It has just been one long, constant stretch of feeling this way.
